name: topicgate
description: Inspect local MQTT state and configure health expectations with optional TopicGate control tools

interface.shortDescription: Secure local access to your MQTT topics
interface.longDescription: Inspect broker profiles, subscriptions, and observed MQTT state in read-only mode. Optional control tools create profiles, manage health expectations, and wait for complete evidence on an active connection.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest observed MQTT values.
